metric_protocol.decode: Pillow convert RGB; uint8; no resize or alignment for metrics
metric_protocol.psnr: 10*log10(255^2/MSE), MSE over all RGB pixel channels; exact equality represented as string Infinity

lpips.input: full-resolution RGB normalized to [-1,1]; no resizing, cropping or alignment
lpips.application: Each candidate image compared with same-run, same-case BF16 output

metric_protocol.threshold_status: Predeclared experiment working gate before supplement inference: per-case LPIPS (AlexNet v0.1) <= 0.15. Qwen-Image-2.1 maintainer approval remains pending; human requested-text/subject/edit review remains pending.
metric_protocol.manual_review: Separate human exact-text/subject/edit fidelity review; retain BF16 errors and all failed or missing cases

hardware_target: H200; all arms on the same observed physical GPU UUID

heldout.role: new prompts and seeds frozen before Phase2 observations; report separately and do not tune from these results then call them untouched heldout

dataset_protocol.candidate_comparison: same-session same-GPU BF16 versus one named candidate; old Phase1 BF16 is historical only

supplement_frozen_20261013.role: three new source images, one fixed edit per image, three seeds

supplement_two_reference.role: New two-reference composition with ordered astronaut and coffee inputs

qualitative_gate_protocol.status: Predeclared operational checks; human review pending and maintainer approval pending
qualitative_gate_protocol.fixed_text: no newly missing, incorrect, or unreadable requested text versus same-run BF16; distinguish pre-existing BF16 errors and ambiguous reading order
qualitative_gate_protocol.subject_and_edit: Preserve each case's specified subject and unchanged regions; complete the requested edit. Review every paired image and record pre-existing BF16 failures separately.
qualitative_gate_protocol.failures_and_black: retain all failed/missing outputs and detect exact all-zero decoded RGB images; near-black cases require visual review; decoded uint8 PNG cannot test upstream float NaN/Inf

case_history: Legacy and heldout labels on the original 24 cases are historical; those cases are no longer unseen. The nine supplement cases were fixed before supplement inference.
expected_text_schema: null, one string, or a list of strings that must all be retained exactly
multi_reference_schema: input_image is null, one absolute path string, or an ordered list of absolute paths; input_image_sha256 is always a matching ordered list.
source_manifest_policy: Source manifests remain byte-identical. This effective schema-1 manifest is authoritative for the supplement run and its predeclared working quality screen.

quality_gate.numeric_rule: LPIPS (AlexNet v0.1) <= 0.15 for each paired image
quality_gate.aggregation: Report numerator/denominator, every failing case, category counts and worst case; do not replace per-case gating with an average.
quality_gate.missing_output: fail; retain the case in the denominator
quality_gate.human_rule: Check requested text exactly, including both sign strings; check subject preservation and requested edit completion. Distinguish existing BF16 errors from newly introduced candidate errors.
